$comment: Neutral tool specs. Parameter names/required-ness are verified against lib/tools/schemas.ts by tests/agent/tools.test.ts. push_agent.py adapts these to Vaani's cURL-tool format (see VERIFY notes there).

tools.name: lookup_caller
tools.description: Call this FIRST on every call. Looks up whether this caller has spoken to the studio recently, and says whether the studio is open right now (studio_open_now). Returns name, whether they are an existing client, and any recent call summaries.

phone.description: Caller's mobile number, e.g. 9876543210 or +919876543210. Use the number the call came from if available, otherwise the number the caller told you.

vaani_call_id.description: This call's unique id, if the system gives you one. Leave it out if you do not have it; never invent one.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Get open consultation slots to offer a caller who passed the checks. Offer two or three of the returned slots in plain words. Never offer a time that was not returned.

visit_type.description: site = designer visits the caller's property; studio = caller visits the studio.

priority.description: true only if the caller was referred by someone who knows Nikhil personally, or has a residential project of about 3000 sq ft or more. Never tell the caller.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to search, 1 to 30. Default 14.

limit.description: How many slots to return, 1 to 8. Default 4.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Book the slot the caller chose. Use ONLY a slot_id returned by get_availability. Include every detail the caller has shared. If the response says the slot is unavailable, apologise and offer its alternatives. Confirm date, time, visit type and the designer's first name to the caller from the response.

vaani_call_id.description: This call's unique id, if the system gives you one. Leave it out if you do not have it; never invent one.

email.description: Caller's email, only if they agreed to share it and you confirmed the spelling.

project_type.description: e.g. 3BHK full redesign, 800 sq ft office, master bedroom.

carpet_area_sqft.description: Approximate carpet area in square feet, if known.

current_state.description: State of the space and scope in a few words, e.g. bare shell; redo kitchen and two bedrooms.

timeline.description: When they need it done, in their words.

budget_volunteered.description: ONLY if the caller volunteered a budget; their words. Never ask for it.

source_or_referrer.description: How they found the studio or who referred them.

tools.name: escalate
tools.description: Use ONLY for an existing client with a complaint about an ongoing project. Alerts the studio head and senior designers immediately. After calling it, promise a callback from a senior person within 15 minutes.

vaani_call_id.description: This call's unique id, if the system gives you one. Leave it out if you do not have it; never invent one.

project.description: Their project, e.g. 2BHK in Viman Nagar.

designer_name.description: Name of their designer, if they said.

issue.description: What is wrong, in one sentence.
